changelog: Added 3D Freecam mode for polygon creation with Left-Click placing and live height adjustments.
Added real-time Floor (Min Z) and Ceiling (Max Z) elevation controls with dynamic wireframe feedback.
Added direct entity enrichment into existing zones via laser aiming or model name/hash.
Added live Laser Entity Inspector tool with one-click quick hiding.
Added zone model management with selective model restoration and 3D wireframe outline preview.
Added ambient traffic and pedestrian suppression options for designated zones.
